label: euclidean: the hit measures Euclidean distance instead of Chebyshev
find: let distance = max(abs(p.x - c.x), abs(p.y - c.y))
replace: let distance = ((p.x - c.x) * (p.x - c.x) + (p.y - c.y) * (p.y - c.y)).squareRoot()

label: edgesWinTies: a later edge handle at the same distance replaces the corner
toleranceTimesZoom: the document tolerance multiplies by zoom
